title: Apportioner service for per-route/model/customer cost and latency decomposition
creator: Priya Sharma
description: Build a dedicated Apportioner microservice that consumes enriched request telemetry and computes deterministic per-route / per-model / per-customer cost and latency decompositions. The service will: 1) ingest event-level usage telemetry (request start/end, tokens, model variant, route id, customer id, server-side metrics) from the pipeline topic (usage.enriched.requests), 2) attribute compute cost and latency to the route/model/customer dimensions using configurable allocation rules (KV-cache hits, batching amortization, fallback model penalties), 3) emit both raw attribution records and periodic rollups into downstream stores (OLAP: BigQuery/ClickHouse; timeseries/TSDB: Cortex/Grafana) and 4) maintain an incremental windowed view to support near-real-time console dashboards and retrospective auditing. Emphasis on deterministic accounting for billing reconciliation and SLA dashboards.
